integrity: Exact proof and finite algebraic checker supplied; scientific review is non-independent and priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Two species; reactant molecularity at most two; strictly positive isolated equilibrium with full zero Jacobian; product molecularity unrestricted. No classification by geometric phase portrait, no converse for each class and no claims about full priority.
title: Five reactant complexes are necessary for an isolated planar quadratic zero-Jacobian equilibrium
